about: Boundary cases for the scope gate (#98, Jev). Four outcomes, the same words screen.ts uses plus one: work, unclear, invalid, out_of_scope. The original 38 in screen-requests.json stay as they are; three of them are restated here with a different expectation because this gate resolves the issue their notes deferred — a case listed here supersedes the same text in screen-requests.json (the eval merges on text). Run: npx tsx apps/api/scripts/eval-scope.ts

cases.text: need my pool cleaned
cases.note: Supersedes screen-requests.json (was work, 'another check handles that' — that check is this one). Real work, pool trade not on the platform.

cases.text: possums in the roof
cases.note: Supersedes screen-requests.json (was work). Pest control is not a covered trade.

cases.text: pools gone green need it cleaned
cases.note: Naive: confident work, since it says 'cleaned'.

cases.text: cockroaches everywhere in the kitchen
cases.note: Pest control.

cases.text: car wont start in the driveway
cases.note: Naive: work, since it is at the property.

cases.text: massive gum over the house needs to come down
cases.note: Big tree removal; a small trim is landscaping.

cases.text: need a split system put in the bedroom
cases.note: Naive: confident electrical. Needs an ARCtick licence; appliance_repair is repairs, not installs.

cases.text: rewire the whole house its 1960s
cases.note: Electrical, but past the $4000 ceiling and a whole-house project.

cases.text: full bathroom reno rip out and retile
cases.note: Tiling trade, but past its ceiling and a multi-trade project.

cases.text: knock down old shed, walls are fibro
cases.note: Demolition plus likely asbestos.

cases.text: plumbing for our new build in box hill
cases.note: Plumbing trade, but a new house.

cases.text: fit out new restaurant kitchen gas sinks lights
cases.note: Commercial fit-out across several trades.

cases.text: landlord, unit 4 needs paint carpet and fix everything before new tenants
cases.note: Whole-unit turnover; carpet is not covered.

cases.text: need a quote for tiling done last month for insurance
cases.note: Naive: work, since it says 'quote' and 'tiling'. It is a report on finished work.

cases.text: smell gas near the meter
cases.note: Emergency, not out of scope: plumbing, safety flag, straight to ASAP. Routing it away loses the job the platform is best placed to send.

cases.text: power point sparking and smoking
cases.note: Emergency electrical: safety flag, ASAP tier. Same reasoning as the gas leak.

cases.text: burst pipe water everywhere
cases.note: Urgent but not life danger: plumbing. Must not trip the safety gate.

cases.text: cafe dishwasher not draining
cases.note: Commercial but small: appliance_repair.

cases.text: gutters chockers need a clean
cases.note: Cleaning, but roofing_gutters covers it.

cases.text: switchboard upgrade, old ceramic fuses
cases.note: Sounds big, but under the electrical ceiling.

cases.text: how much to replace a hot water system
cases.note: Price question that still names the job. No address needed yet.

cases.text: fix this
cases.note: Vague words, the photos are the job. The gate must not block on the words alone.

cases.text: quote me for a new deck out the back
cases.note: Carpentry; 'quote' is not paperwork when the work has not happened.

cases.text: 12 Smith St Parramatta
cases.note: Address only.

cases.text: how much do yous charge
cases.note: Naive: invalid as a general question, which loses a real lead.

cases.text: whats the sparkys licence number
cases.note: A question with no job in it. The app shows licences on bids; nothing to price.

cases.text: the sink
cases.note: The reply is still unclear — but only the words are evidence here, so this is the second clarify, not a block.

cases.text: can you come have a look at the place
cases.note: A visit with no job named.

cases.text: my tenant says the aircon is leaking, i'm overseas
cases.note: Landlord, remote, but it is a job: appliance_repair.

cases.text: need someone to mow and whipper snipper a 2 acre block
cases.note: Mowing a big block is still landscaping and still inside its ceiling. Was out_of_scope in the first cut of this file; the label was wrong, not the gate.
